findings.title: The home page and How it works explain Dummy Run as a persona-based exploratory testing tool
The docs say the runner writes the run record and the reviewer completes it, which is the closest thing to a verification gate
The run record example shows Firefox as a supported browser in the recorded run
I found browser details in the schema/example, but not a dedicated supported-browsers list
